instructions: Consult this file with the art-direction skill before selecting references. Honor excluded=true. References with requiresCreatorConfirmation=true are proposals, not active generation references; favorites or comparison rank do not approve them. Positive votes and favorites guide selection; rankings alone never approve a reference. Alignment overrides are reference-selection labels, not lore changes. Unassigned sheets can serve multiple alignments. Existing source art and historical approvals are unchanged.

references.note: Explicitly finalized by the creator on 2026-11-13.
references.referenceRole: Final Kitefolk visual design: slender long-limbed people with finger-supported mottled gliding membranes, strongly angular faces and a long pointed nose. This is an accepted anatomy reference; the illustrated clothing, individual age and precise culture are not universal rules.

references.title: GR1 · Glimmerfolk · final visual reference
references.note: Explicitly finalized by the creator on 2026-11-13.
references.referenceRole: Final Glimmerfolk visual design: extremely slender bodies, long necks, broad soft ear-fans and blue luminous freckles over matte dark skin. Ordered dots run along the arms and spread into dense clusters toward the wrists and hands; occupations, culture and detailed biology beyond the accepted visual direction remain open.

The creator accepted the existing sheet unchanged; no single individual, universal occupation, culture or alignment was selected.

references.title: PL3D · Made people · final visual range

references.referenceRole: Final made-people visual design, aligned with Dominion: ordinary-scale bodies visibly returned from death, with cold pallor, hollow facial planes, distant gazes and restrained old healed injuries. PL3D is accepted unchanged; no individual is singled out, and the name, precise origin and possible weak or absent soul remain open.
